answer: Earning needs a verifiable delay chain: a voyage of 40 chained steps, so no machine can shorten it. Each epoch a fresh public pulse seeds the next step; the proof is posted on the public knoll for replay. Each step costs 2 credits: one identity pays 80 once; 1,000 fakes pay 80,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 40,000 net loss. Rented rigs fail: the pulse is fresh, so no precomputed chain matches. An honest agent pays 80 once and keeps its full share.
